newsitem.title: INDIA: India Ballarpur to market Ahlstrom paper.
newsitem.headline: India Ballarpur to market Ahlstrom paper.

text.p: India's Ballarpur Industries Limited (BILT) and Finland's Ahlstrom Paper Group on Tuesday entered into an agreement to jointly market speciality paper products, officials said.
"We are going to market speciality papers. We will also start manufacturing of automotive filters," Krister Ahlstrom, president of A. Ahlstrom Corporation, told a newsconference.
Ahlstrom signed the agreement (MoU) with Ballarpur's joint managing directors, Vikram Thapar and Gautam Thapar.
BILT will sell Ahlstrom Paper Group's products, speciality papers like label release, anti-corrosive, and pre-impregnated furniture foils in India, the company said in a statement.
BILT, part of the Thapar group, said it was India's largest manufacturer of writing, printing and speciality grade papers. It has an annual turnover of 15 billion rupees.
"In a reciprocal arrangement, Ahlstrom Paper has in mind certain papers in the BILT range which it could successfully market in Europe and elsewhere," the statement said.
Finland's Ahlstrom Paper Group Oy, a part of A. Ahlstrom Corporation, is a private concern of the Global Paper and Engineering Group, the statement said.
Officials gave no details of the investment by the two companies.
"I don't have the details yet," said Vikram Thapar, joint managing director of BILT.
The MOU also envisages joint investments in new or rebuilt paper machine projects, the statement said.
